name: @pipeworx/mcp-science

tools.name: get_iss_location
tools.description: Fetch the International Space Station's current latitude, longitude, and Unix timestamp from the Open Notify API. No inputs required; returns a real-time position fix.

tools.name: get_earthquakes
tools.description: Retrieve up to 20 globally recent earthquakes from the USGS FDSN service, filtered by lookback period (1–30 days, default 1) and minimum magnitude (default 4.0). Returns magnitude, location name, depth (km), coordinates, time, and tsunami warning flag.

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Check current air quality at a latitude/longitude. Returns US AQI score and category plus PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, and CO levels.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 40.7128. Required — this tool does not geocode city names.

tools.name: get_apod
tools.description: Get NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day with image URL, title, and explanation. Optionally specify a date (e.g., '2024-01-15').

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-science forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the science pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
